description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

This setting cleans out stale entries created by the Windows Push Notification Platform (WPN) and Windows Notification Facility (WFN) which under some conditions leads to slow sign-ins. Only enable this setting if directed by a Microsoft Support Engineer.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\CleanOutNotifications
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
